messages:
elaine: quick heads-up — Celeste Health wants to POC a new model for their clinical summarization flow. they asked for a 13B-ish open model with good accuracy and low mem footprint. can eng/solutions confirm fit and ETA to onboard into our hosted catalog?

arjun: what model name/version did they send over? any special ops (streaming, tool calls)?

elaine: customer shared 'garnet-13b-q4' (community fork) + they want streaming for partial outputs, and ability to pin variant for canary. also asked pricing ballpark for hosted vs dedicated for a 100rps sustained workload.

mike: quick notes: garnet-13b-q4 looks like standard transformer, KV cache supported. quantized q4 path = lower mem but may need custom kernels on older A10s. rough GPU mem: ~22–28GB for LL=2048 with KV caching disabled; with prefix caching could be lower. streaming should work but we need to validate tokenization and stop sequence handling.

sara: for 100 rps sustained, hosted unit-cost estimate depends on batch tuning. naive: if single-token latency ~60ms we can batch a bit. ballpark pricing if served hosted (opt): ~$Xk/mo — i'll send formal numbers after bench. dedicated quote will be capacity-based commit.

judy: security flags from enterprise: they require SOC2 audit evidence, customer-managed KMS for private, and audit logs for token-level request tracing. will Celeste do private or hosted? they prefer hosted but need SOC2 + VPD.

elaine: they prefer hosted initially but may go private for PHI later. they also gave a 30-question security questionnaire — can you confirm what we're comfortable answering re: model training data and PII handling?

arjun: for onboarding steps i propose: 1) compatibility check (tokenizer + seq length), 2) bench (latency/cost at target seq dist), 3) small eval on customer prompts, 4) create a catalog entry + canary rollout policy. if any gaps (kernels/quantization) we note fallback variant.

mike: i'm starting a quick compatibility run now — will check tok mismatch, max positions, and run a 10k-token throughput sample. will post results.

mike: (log) ```
[2026-03-21 15:05:12] loading model garnet-13b-q4
[2026-03-21 15:05:32] tokenizer ok: vocab matches, no special unk mapping
[2026-03-21 15:06:03] max_positions: 2048
[2026-03-21 15:10:01] perf sample (1client, seq=512): p50=45ms p95=120ms GPU mem=24.8GB
```

arjun: looks promising. p95 will need batching or maybe a lite variant for low-latency SLAs. I can draft a model_profile config for the catalog. example config snippet: 
```
model: garnet-13b-q4
variant: q4_0
max_seq: 2048
streaming: true
preferred_kernels: [tensorcore-optimized, fallback-avx]
canary_policy: 5% traffic -> 25% over 24h
```

sara: Judy — to answer security Qs: hosted + SOC2: we can provide audit logs and our SOC2 cert. KMS for hosted customers is not customer-managed by default; that requires Private deployment. i'll flag this for the commercial thread.

judy: noted. also ask Celeste if they need data residency (EU) — will affect region routing.

elaine: customer is US-only for now. ok next: ETA to have garnet live in catalog (canary ready) — arjun/mike?

mike: if no kernel blockers, i can finish benching and create a build artifact in ~2 business days. need infra to run a few more stress runs against our hosting shapes.

arjun: i'll prep the model_profile and onboarding checklist today. if mike's perf numbers hold, we can schedule a canary deploy by EOD +2.

deploy-bot: model-build triggered for garnet-13b-q4 by mike. job id: mb-20260321-7732

mike: deploy-bot pinged — started stress runs. will post updated numbers + memory breakdown in next message.

elaine: perfect. i'll update Celeste with a short timeline and ask for their prompt set (50 samples) for eval. plan to sync Wed for demo. :thumbsup:

sara: will draft hosted vs dedicated pricing and a private-deploy delta for Judy to review.

judy: thanks. if Celeste insists on KMS before contract, we should offer Private timeline + expected lead time (2–4 weeks).

arjun: noted. i'll include fallback variants in the catalog entry and a note on quantization caveats.

mike: quick follow-up (numbers): stress run @100rps sustained, seq dist mean=256, p95=98ms, GPU util ~72%, effective tokens/sec per GPU = 28k. OK for hosted small pool.

elaine: awesome — i'll send this summary to Celeste and book the Wed demo slot. thanks team! :rocket:
